steps.caption: Open Capture and scroll to Add files.
PDF and Word quotations, brochures, LOIs, leases, notes, cards, photos and voice notes are all accepted here.
Open 'Link to a record' and pick the requirement this quote is for: Marigold Loop, 20,000 sf in Kharadi.
'Quotation from' says who sent it — landlord, managed-office operator or fit-out partner.
Recognised as a Quotation. Open it.
The type was worked out from the file and its keywords. 'Pattern matching — check every value' means practice mode.
Original file opens the PDF exactly as uploaded — it is always kept.
Rent: 'Rs. 85 per sq ft per month' → ₹85 per sq ft per month, CAM extra — found on page 1.
Chargeable area 20,000 sq ft stays chargeable — carpet, chargeable and super built-up are never converted.
Lock-in, deposit and escalation come from page 2. Every value keeps its page and wording.
Proposals: create a quote on the requirement — approve it in Review.
Now the landlord sends a revised quote. Back to Capture.
Same requirement, and choose the revised quotation.
Rent is now ₹95. 'Differs from the saved value' — this is version 2.
The ₹85 from the first quote is kept, not overwritten. The change waits in the Review queue.
Recent files on Capture list both quotes, their type and whether they wait for you.
